topic_name: CPF Housing Grant for Resale Flats (Families)
question_template: For a {household_type} household with citizenship {citizenship}, first-timer status {first_timer} and average gross monthly household income of {household_income}, buying a {flat_type} resale flat, does the CPF Housing Grant for Resale Flats (Families) apply, and what amount is stated for this citizenship and flat type?

overview.quote: Under the CPF Housing Grant Scheme, you may qualify for a housing subsidy of up to $80,000 to help with the purchase of a resale flat.
